d: US President Donald Trump addressed a range of issues at a White House news conference, including the Russia-Ukraine war, trade tensions with Canada, and US-China relations. Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin wanted to end the Ukraine war through diplomacy and expressed confidence in their relationship. He also accused Canada of unfair trade practices and discussed semiconductor exports to China, calling for a second chance for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Trump also addressed Iran's alleged dirty bomb threat and nuclear security cooperation between the US, Russia and China.
